# korean-word-of-the-day — static two-view resting screen, deterministic by date, no network

> [!warning] **no blank panels** — every pin entry is shape-complete so the screen can never render blank panels; enforced by `tests/test_korean_pin.js` behavioral tests.

## Behavioral contracts

- **deterministic rotation** — the word of the day is chosen by local calendar date with no API, tokens, or network involved; enforced by `words.js` rotation logic.
- **data-only word additions** — adding a word never changes layout; enforced by `words.js` entry shape mirroring exactly what the Resting Screen design renders.
- **no blank panels** — every pin entry is shape-complete so the screen can never render blank panels; enforced by `tests/test_korean_pin.js` behavioral tests.
- **offline operation** — the screen works with the internet down; enforced by the absence of any network call in the static files.

## Health

- **aliveness signal** — the screen renders when `index.html` is opened in a browser; there is no endpoint, query, or timer to check.
- **failure** — a blank panel renders, or a word entry is missing a required field (`ko`, `roman`, `sound`, `pos`, `meaning`, `syl`, `ex`).
- **quiet** — no activity is normal; the screen is static and only changes when the local calendar date advances. Do not conflate "no activity" with "broken".

## Policies & SLAs

| name | value | source config |
|---|---|---|
| word entry syllable range | 1–4 syllables | `words.js` |
| design-preferred syllable range | 2–3 syllables | `words.js` |
| hero line auto-shrink threshold | past 4 syllables | `words.js` |
